sanskrit_verse:
स्वजात्यतिक्रमे पुंसां उक्तम् उत्तमसाहसम् ।
विपर्यये मध्यमस् तु प्रतीलोमे प्रमापणम् ॥
transliteration: svajātyatikrame puṃsām uktam uttamasāhasam | viparyaye madhyamas tu prātilome pramāpaṇam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a man transgresses the boundaries of his own varna-dharma, it is declared as Uttama Sāhasa; in case of reversal, the middle category applies; and in case of violation against natural order, it leads to loss of status.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with inherent dharma, not imposition
Causation arises from deviation from svadharma, not external fault
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by conscious choice within one's evolutionary stage
Restoration logic operates through realignment with source-consciousness structure
Consciousness alignment corrects distortion without punitive intervention
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that violations of intrinsic svadharma constitute the highest form of transgression. The court must assess not intent or social harm, but the degree of misalignment from constitutional consciousness-order. Responsibility is calibrated based on individual capacity for recognition and restoration, bypassing punitive frameworks entirely.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causal distortion originates in deviation from svabhāva. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential dissonance when dharma is violated. Proportional responsibility aligns with the depth of consciousness-awareness at time of action. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that correction occurs via reintegration, not infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Engage Completion Ritual for Karmic Discharge
Reintegrate Individual Will with Cosmic Order
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law proceeds from Sanātana Dharma, unmodified by human interpretation. Justice is executed solely for restoration, never punishment. Reality responds only to consciousness alignment. Dharma stands restored.
